title: Text
description:
A text chart shows the result without a table: each row is its cells joined by
`style.separator`; newlines in a cell start new lines and long lines wrap. Good for
logs, messages and `lua://` output. See `:help dbdash-chart-types`.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-' || (12 - i) || ' minutes') AS at,
       CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN i % 3 = 0 THEN 'WARN ' ELSE 'INFO ' END AS level,
       'request ' || i || ' served in ' || (i * 37 % 200) || ' ms' AS message
FROM n

show.title: separator, column_list
show.description: `column_list` picks and orders the columns, `separator` joins them (default a space).

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)

show.title: highlight, reverse, line_numbers
show.description:
`highlight` colors the lines that match a Vim regex (the first rule wins), `reverse`
puts the last row first (newest on top), `line_numbers` numbers the rows.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-' || (12 - i) || ' minutes') AS at,
       CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN i % 3 = 0 THEN 'WARN ' ELSE 'INFO ' END AS level,
       'request ' || i || ' served in ' || (i * 37 % 200) || ' ms' AS message
FROM n

show.title: max_lines, color
show.description:
`max_lines` shows the first N lines and how many more there are; `style.color` colors
the text (CSS `color`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'A long message that does not fit on one line of the panel wraps at the spaces, as text does in a browser.' AS t
UNION ALL SELECT 'first line' || char(10) || 'second line of the same cell'

show.title: wrap (default), newlines
show.description:
Long lines wrap at spaces (`wrap: true`, CSS `white-space: normal`; `"char"` breaks
anywhere); newlines in a cell start new lines.

query.sql: SELECT 'A long message that does not fit on one line of the panel is cut at the edge, wherever that edge happens to be in your window.' AS t

show.title: wrap: false, ellipsis
show.description:
`wrap: false` keeps one line per row and cuts it at the edge (`ellipsis` marks the cut,
CSS `text-overflow`).

query.sql: SELECT 'centered' AS t UNION ALL SELECT 'text' UNION ALL SELECT NULL

show.title: text_align: center, null_text
show.description:
`text_align` is CSS `text-align` for the lines (left, center, right); `null_text` is
what a NULL shows (default nothing).
